chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Mūsā ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام.
Regarding a slave who slanders a chaste free woman,
he said: “He is to be flogged eighty lashes, because he is only flogged on account of her right.”

key_terms.قَذَفَ: falsely accused of unchastity; committed slander
key_terms.مُحْصَنَةً: a chaste woman protected by lawful status and chastity
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is to be flogged as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave slanders a chaste free woman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the hadd punishment for slander against a chaste free woman. It states that a slave who commits such slander receives eighty lashes, emphasizing that the punishment here is tied to the violated right of the woman.
